Something that's the latest is the newest, most recent example of that thing. For example, some people always need to have the latest cellphone model, while you're perfectly happy with the one that came out three years ago. You can listen to a singer's latest single, or read a novelist's latest book — the ones most recently written and released. # latest

 American

[ley-tist] / ˈleɪ tɪst /

1. most recent; current.

   > latest fashions.
2. last.

## noun

 latests

  plural

1. the latest, the most recent news, development, disclosure, etc..

   > This is the latest in personal computers.

## idioms

1. at the latest, not any later than (a specified time).

   > Be at the airport by 7 o'clock at the latest.
